Plot every view an object has and return the plots as one list

Source: R/wildcards.R
plot_all.Rd

plot_all() plots every view that an object of the package has, and returns the plots as one list. Printing the list shows each plot in turn.

Usage

plot_all(x)

Arguments

x

Any object returned by the package: a fitted model, pooled imputations, an enumeration grid, a comparison, a bootstrap result, a sensitivity analysis or a diagnostics result.

Value

A latents_plots list of ggplot objects, named by view. Printing it draws every plot; in an interactive session R waits for a key press before each new plot.

Errors: latents_not_a_fit when x is not a fit, grid or other result of the package, for example a data frame; latents_nothing_to_plot when none of the object's views can be drawn; latents_missing_package when ggplot2 is not installed.

Details

Which plots the list holds depends on the object. The names of the list are the names of the views:

  • a profile, class or transition fit of lpa(), lca(), multilpa(), multilca() or lta() (class multilpa_transitions): the views its data allow among profiles, bars, heatmap, raincloud, parallel, pairs, responses, probabilities, sequences, transitions, sizes, entropy, posteriors and avepp. A fit with two or more group classes adds group_sizes, group_posteriors, group_entropy and group_avepp;

  • a fit of another family: the views of its own plot(), then the four classification views sizes, posteriors, entropy and avepp. A mixture regression has fitted and coefficients; one that classifies persons also trajectories, individuals and classification; a growth mixture has those three, coefficients and random; a general transition fit transitions, profiles and sequences; an additive fit means, variances and intercepts; a cross-level fit profiles, group_means and composition. When such a fit classifies at two levels, each classification view is drawn twice, as sizes_individuals, sizes_groups and so on;

  • pooled imputations: the pooled estimates of each level the pooled table has, among profile, group and measurement;

  • an enumeration grid: criteria (every criterion, as plot_criteria()), entropy, avepp, deltas, heatmap, smallest, trust and tree. A grid of group-class families has criteria, entropy, avepp and tree. A grid with several trees has one plot per tree, named tree_ and the tree's name;

  • a comparison, a bootstrap test, a bootstrap table of parameter_inference() or a sensitivity analysis: its one plot, named plot;

  • a diagnostics() result: the plots of the fit it checked.

Only the views the object can draw are returned. A view that was tried and refused is left out and named in a message (Not drawn for this object: ...).

See also

overview() prints the summary and the checks as well; the functions named after single views, such as plot_profiles(), plot_sizes() and plot_criteria().

Examples

fit <- lpa(faithful, c("eruptions", "waiting"), n_profiles = 2,
           n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
plot_all(fit)
